findings.message: Account `mint_reserve` uses `init_if_needed`; review for re-initialization or state-reset risk.
findings.help: Prefer #[account(init, ...)] when possible. If init_if_needed is necessary, confirm the account cannot be abused to reset state.

findings.message: Mutable token account `prize_pool` has no `token::mint` constraint; an attacker can substitute a token account for a different mint
findings.help: Add #[account(mut, token::mint = <mint_field>)] to pin this account to the expected mint, or use associated_token::mint = <mint_field>.
